description: This file defines a migration class for database schema changes related to 'node_resource' and its category in a PHP project. It contains methods to generate SQL for migrating up (applying changes) and down (reverting changes).

classes.name: GoteoChannelResources
classes.description: A class that manages database migration steps for creating and dropping tables related to node resource categories and adding/removing related columns in the node_resource table.

methods.name: preUp
methods.description: Placeholder method for code to execute before applying the 'up' migration.

methods.name: postUp
methods.description: Placeholder method for code to execute after applying the 'up' migration.

methods.name: preDown
methods.description: Placeholder method for code to execute before reverting the migration.

methods.description: Placeholder method for code to execute after reverting the migration.

methods.name: getDownSQL
methods.description: Returns the SQL statements to drop columns and tables, reverting the migration.
